derived_from: electronics_enclosure_v17 drive layout; single-channel review assembly
status: visual/mechanical packaging candidate; not a print or pressure-test release

motor.output_shaft_flat_dimension_status: measured from official STEP; verify physical shaft tolerance

coupling.type: D-bore to round extension shaft coupling
coupling.through_bolt: M5 x 45 mm proxy with 0.8 mm washer; placed above the shortened 16.5 mm gear-bore shaft engagement; nominal thread engagement 10 mm
coupling.possible_circlip_groove_source: user-supplied design note; not confirmed in DJI drawing
coupling.groove_status: provisional location; measure actual motor shaft before machining

motor_output_shaft_seal.type: skeleton oil seal envelope proxy; exact vendor and part number not selected
motor_output_shaft_seal.shaft_running_surface: cylindrical OD of the D-bore sleeve, not the bare D shaft
motor_output_shaft_seal.interface_status: provisional envelope; confirm seal lip geometry, interference, material, and pressure direction against purchased part
motor_output_shaft_seal.boundary_role: secondary motor-side barrier; retain the horizontal reel-shaft seal as the primary wet/dry boundary

drive.reel_position_adjustment: moved 1.5 mm wetward from v18 to clear the labyrinth ring; guide port plane moves with the reel and preserves the straight radial tangent route
drive.right_angle_gears: KHK MMSA1.5-20R + MMSA1.5-20L dimensional envelopes; tooth form not modeled

stock_miter_gear.screw_layout_status: 90 degree angular layout is a model assumption; verify actual stock gear before machining
stock_miter_gear.screw_contact_status: nominal face contact; actual screw length and shaft fit require hardware measurement
stock_miter_gear.input_bolt_head_relief_status: inferred clearance in envelope model to pass M5 clamp screw head; verify against actual KHK gear cavity
stock_miter_gear.tooth_geometry_status: catalog-dimension envelope only; tooth form and mesh are not modeled

drive.input_bearing: SKF 6000-2RS1 envelope, 10 x 26 x 8 mm; moved to clear 20 mm coupling
drive.output_bearing: SKF 3200 ATN9 envelope, 10 x 30 x 14 mm
drive.rotary_seal: SKF 10 x 22 x 7 HMSA10 RG envelope candidate on horizontal reel-output shaft

reel.d_bore_fit_status: preliminary 0.15 mm radial and flat clearances; calibrate a printed fit coupon
reel.retainer_screw: M4 x 10 mm socket-head screw proxy; M4 tapped hole modeled without thread form
reel.cable_exit: straight line tangent to outermost cable layer and aligned to chamfered guide port
